_about: In-battle stage tables (List 26 #250). Lock the values #17 flagged PROPOSED. Stages are battle state only: start 0 on entry, reset on switch-out, never stored.

statStages.fractions: (2+s)/2 for s>=0, 2/(2-s) for s<0; applied as floor(stat * mult)

accuracyEvasionStages.hitRule: connects when seeded draw < accuracy(move) * accMult(attacker stage) / evaMult(defender stage); move accuracy null = never rolls, cannot miss

criticalStages._note: stage 3 means 3 or more; crit damage x1.5 in #248
